shots.title: Lake Pavilion
shots.scene: a primary bathroom in a villa on a lake, soft overcast daylight through a wide window looking onto still water and misty hills. The walls and floor are clad in large porcelain slabs (1200 x 2400 mm, thin 2 mm joints), honed satin finish. A freestanding pale stone bathtub in the middle, a floating oak vanity with a brushed-brass tap, a walk-in shower behind a single clear glass pane, linen towels, one olive branch in a vase
shots.stone: a near-black ground with fine white veins
shots.alt: A lake-view bathroom clad in Nero Marquina, with a pale stone bath

shots.title: The Cliff House
shots.scene: a primary bedroom in a penthouse above the sea, soft morning light through sheer linen curtains. The whole wall behind a low oak bed is one continuous run of large porcelain slabs (1600 x 3200 mm, thin 2 mm joints). Satin finish. Oatmeal bed linen, a ceramic table lamp, a wool rug on a pale floor
shots.stone: a warm white ground with soft grey veins
shots.alt: A primary bedroom whose wall behind the bed is a run of Statuario slabs
